title: harbor-master-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master mails with no verb and nothing uses it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a; the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 4 tickets at a rest carry a watchme probe under cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/probes/ (0354c0269ff7, 0cde908b8fbe, 2b16d2d8b056, faa51bcfbdfc). Read 2026-10-03: all four triggers are fails-shaped (_trigger TRUE on the ticket's falsifier conditions: one hand only, a bypassed or never-refusing gate, a silent retirement, an owner read that did not bind); all four already post to='harbor_master' with no verb (verbless mail falls through declared_verbs to the base receive, which only logs), so none retargets — they gain verb 'watch'. Each holds a slug in _OWNING_TICKET and gains _TICKET_ID. One proof imports a harbor_master probe (test_clearance imports survey_the_refusals from clearance_actually_gates) and asserts nothing of its PROBE. Each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, <its predicate>), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing harbor_master spec lacks the receiver, or if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id. WRONG INTENT if a harbor_master probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 4 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which probes and how: 0354c0269ff7 a_second_hand_meets_the_gate (fails=_trigger), 0cde908b8fbe clearance_actually_gates (fails=_trigger), 2b16d2d8b056 a_superseded_intention_is_never_silent (fails=_trigger), faa51bcfbdfc boat_owner_comes_from_the_boat (fails=_trigger). In each file under cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/probes/: append watch_carry to the existing 'from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...' line; use the probe's id constant (named per probe below, added as `_TICKET_ID = "<id>"` after the import block when absent); in PROBE = Probe(...) replace 'carry=_carry,' with 'verb="watch",' and 'carry=watch_carry(<const>, _carry, <pred>),'. All four hold _OWNING_TICKET as a slug, not the id; that constant stays as it is (their carry and owning_ticket read it), and a new _TICKET_ID carries the 12-hex id for watch_carry. Nothing else in a probe changes. (2) watch_carry exists in cairn/tools/base/probe.py (8ecb99998254); do not edit it. (3) Specs: each ticket's watchme spec whose probe starts with cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/probes/ gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}, through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write. (4) Proof: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_harbor_master_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'c078ff7ef0cd': {'all': 'test_harbor_master_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, modeled on cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py. (5) Every proof that imports a converted probe stays green: run them.

decisions.text: D1: the probes — In each of these files under cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/probes/: a_second_hand_meets_the_gate.py (0354c0269ff7: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger), clearance_actually_gates.py (0cde908b8fbe: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger), a_superseded_intention_is_never_silent.py (2b16d2d8b056: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger), boat_owner_comes_from_the_boat.py (faa51bcfbdfc: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger) — append watch_carry to the existing `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line; where the constant is to be added, add `_TICKET_ID = "<its id>"` after the import block; in `PROBE = Probe(...)` replace `carry=_carry,` with `verb="watch",` and `carry=watch_carry(<constant>, _carry, <its predicate>),`. All four hold _OWNING_TICKET as a slug, not the id; that constant stays as it is (their carry and owning_ticket read it), and a new _TICKET_ID carries the 12-hex id for watch_carry. Nothing else changes; watch_carry is not edited.

D3: the proof — Create cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_harbor_master_probes_report_to_the_watch.py: a copy of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py with the docstring naming cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master and ticket c078ff7ef0cd; PROVES = {'c078ff7ef0cd': {'all': 'test_harbor_master_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}; BERTH = 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/probes/'; _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[6] (the repo root: the directory holding cairn/); teeth renamed test_every_standing_harbor_master_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_harbor_master_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_harbor_master_probes_report_to_the_watch. Structure, in full: imports importlib, json, subprocess, sys, Path; _REPO_ROOT on sys.path; parse_workflow from cairn.tools.base.transitions; watchme_spec_error from cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec; _main_tree() = Path(git -C _REPO_ROOT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir).parent falling back to _REPO_ROOT; _tickets() = _main_tree().parent/'CairnCommons'/'tickets'; _standing() = (id, doc, spec) for each ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme spec's probe starts with BERTH, asserting non-empty; the posts tooth imports each probe module and asserts PROBE.verb == 'watch', PROBE.to == 'harbor_master', payload({}) carries ticket == the id, holds a bool, non-empty finding when holds is False (invariants only); the receiver tooth asserts spec['receiver'] == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error(doc) names no receiver fault; a __main__ block runs each, prints PASS/FAIL, exits 1 on any failure. No classes.

D4: the specs' receiver — Ticket files are /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/<id>-<slug>.json (glob '<id>-*.json', exactly one). For each of 0354c0269ff7, 0cde908b8fbe, 2b16d2d8b056, faa51bcfbdfc: doc = json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); the watchme is a dict or list of dicts; the spec whose 'probe' starts with 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/probes/' gets spec['receiver'] = {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}; then cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(p, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver, harbor_master\'s watch verb (c078ff7ef0cd)') — write(path, text, *, verb, why), text the WHOLE modified ticket. Run it as a script file (a shell command naming a record path and writing is refused by the artifact gate).

D5: green, seal, commit — Run cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_harbor_master_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0) and the probe-importing proofs (test_clearance); each must be green. Seal with `bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_harbor_master_probes_report_to_the_watch.py <the probe-importing proofs>` (it runs each and writes its validation beside it). Commit with message 'c078ff7ef0cd: harbor_master probes report to the watch' (the commit runs the reseal ladder, so allow an hour); commit the commons.

Measured 2026-10-03 (grep of cairn, skills, bin for the four probe names outside probes/): test_clearance.py is the only proof that imports a converted probe; test_harbor_asks_the_real_host.py names clearance_actually_gates in a comment, clearance.py names boat_owner_comes_from_the_boat in a docstring, and test_exemption_set.py:442 matches the name inside the exemption set's untriaged list (unchanged by the conversion, since the file path stays). The commons is committed with: git -C ../CairnCommons add -A && git -C ../CairnCommons commit -m '<msg>' (cairn artifact check runs at commit).
